items.title: A few favours
items.text: Five small things, and next time

notes: We have five things to talk about. First the new rules, especially the free final year that started last autumn. Then how children grow between three and six, and what a day at kindergarten looks like. The third part is the heart of tonight: what helps at home with sleep, screens, outdoor time, food and eyesight, and how the youngest children settle in. Then safety. Last, a few small favours we would like to ask.
